# English academic mode — author override, 21 October 2026

The author explicitly extended lieflat to the English manuscript. This project mode overrides the upstream exclusion of foreign-language paragraphs. Apply it after evidence and prose checks in the existing G3 scope; inspect all six manuscript sections. The Chinese corpus statistics in the upstream skill are not evidence of English usage frequency or a validated English detection score.

Use only an identifiable counterpart of an upstream numbered rule:

- Rule 1: an invented misconception followed by its reversal. Preserve substantive scientific contrasts, negative findings and identification limits.
- Rule 3: consecutive sentences repeat a subject–verb–object pattern, component order and punctuation. Reorder the minimum part of one sentence; do not alter paragraph or citation positions. Necessary parallel reporting of outcomes, models, intervals or procedures is exempt.
- Rules 4–5: an ornamental dash or empty colon lead-in. Leave numerical ranges, technical compounds, equations, structured abstract labels and meaningful definitions intact.
- Rule 8: replace an action nominalisation with its existing verb, or use a concrete value already supplied for the same object. Do not introduce new values, replace a necessary summary with a different estimand, or treat nominalisation itself as a fault.
- Rule 9: an empty formulaic opening; remove only when it has no logical function.
- Rule 11: an evaluative paragraph opening lacks a referent. Supply a referent already present in context, without adding a claim.

Rules about Chinese enumeration punctuation, translation into Chinese, Chinese ordinal headings or Chinese particles do not automatically transfer to English. Do not force their use. Unmatched sentences remain verbatim; a section with no clear hit is a valid outcome.

For every edit record the upstream rule number, trigger, before/after and preservation check. Keep numbers, units, models, estimands, uncertainty, negation, hedges, references, headings, paragraph order and evidence comments. Verify the combined manuscript against section files. Do not promise AI-detector scores.
